info.name: Kubernetes Services List Services in a namespace

params.name: namespace
params.description: Namespace name to scope the request.

params.name: labelSelector
params.description: Label selector expression to filter resources. Supports equality (=, ==, !=) and set-based (in, notin, exists) operators.

params.name: fieldSelector
params.description: Field selector expression to filter resources by field values. Example: metadata.name=my-service

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of items to return. Use with continue for pagination.

params.name: continue
params.description: Pagination token from a previous response's metadata.continue field.

params.name: resourceVersion
params.description: Resource version for watch operations. Returns events after this version.

params.name: watch
params.description: If true, return a watch stream of changes instead of a list.

items.docs: Returns a list of all Services in the specified namespace. Services provide stable virtual IPs and DNS names for pod groups. Supports label and field filtering, and streaming via the watch parameter.

params.name: namespace
params.description: Namespace name to scope the request.

params.name: dryRun
params.description: If 'All', the request is validated and processed without persisting. Useful to verify changes before applying them.

items.docs: Creates a new Service in the specified namespace. The Service type determines how the service is exposed: ClusterIP for internal access, NodePort to add a node-level port, LoadBalancer to provision a cloud load balancer, or ExternalName to alias an external DNS name.

params.name: namespace
params.description: Namespace name to scope the request.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the Service resource.

items.docs: Returns the specified Service including its cluster IP, type, port mappings, selector, session affinity configuration, and load balancer status.

params.name: namespace
params.description: Namespace name to scope the request.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the Service resource.

params.name: dryRun
params.description: If 'All', the request is validated and processed without persisting. Useful to verify changes before applying them.

items.docs: Replaces the full specification of the specified Service. Updates to selector take effect immediately; changing the type between ClusterIP, NodePort, and LoadBalancer may trigger infrastructure changes.

params.name: namespace
params.description: Namespace name to scope the request.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the Service resource.

params.name: dryRun
params.description: If 'All', the request is validated and processed without persisting. Useful to verify changes before applying them.

items.docs: Applies a partial update to the specified Service. Supports strategic-merge-patch, merge-patch, and apply-patch content types for targeted field updates without replacing the full resource.

params.name: namespace
params.description: Namespace name to scope the request.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the Service resource.

params.name: gracePeriodSeconds
params.description: Duration in seconds to wait before forcefully deleting the resource.

params.name: dryRun
params.description: If 'All', the request is validated and processed without persisting. Useful to verify changes before applying them.

items.docs: Deletes the specified Service. For LoadBalancer-type services, the associated external load balancer will be deprovisioned. ClusterIP is released back to the IP pool.

info.name: Kubernetes Services List Services across all namespaces

params.name: labelSelector
params.description: Label selector expression to filter resources. Supports equality (=, ==, !=) and set-based (in, notin, exists) operators.

params.name: fieldSelector
params.description: Field selector expression to filter resources by field values. Example: metadata.name=my-service

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of items to return. Use with continue for pagination.

params.name: watch
params.description: If true, return a watch stream of changes instead of a list.

items.docs: Returns a list of all Services across every namespace in the cluster. Useful for cluster-wide service discovery and auditing. Supports label and field filtering.

params.name: namespace
params.description: Namespace name to scope the request.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the Service resource.

items.docs: Returns the status subresource of the specified Service, including load balancer ingress IPs or hostnames and any provisioning conditions.

params.name: namespace
params.description: Namespace name to scope the request.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the Service resource.

items.docs: Replaces the status subresource of the specified Service. Used by load balancer controllers to report the provisioned external IP or hostname back to the Service resource.
